terminal_objective: Prove one single cognitive identity can take a difficult real computer-work goal from ambiguous request to verified finished result while using durable Brain state and resuming after a session boundary.
mission_requirements: interpret a real consequential goal rather than a synthetic predicate
inspect existing context and constraints from Project Brain
discover and use tools/apps appropriate to the task
perform meaningful computer actions in browser or professional software
create or modify a consequential artifact or software result
inspect the actual result and detect at least one real issue if present
correct the result rather than merely report the issue
persist mission state and evidence to Project Brain before a session boundary
resume from persisted state without repeating completed work
verify the final result independently from its own planning narrative
write durable evidence and lessons back to Project Brain
anti_shortcuts: do not borrow persistence proof from a deterministic worker
do not borrow cognition proof from another chat
do not compose booleans from different identities
do not count benchmark completion as mission completion
do not promote from one narrow HTTP or repository task
success_definition: ICW-WORK-ASTRA-1, as one cognitive identity, completes the concrete Capability Reality Auditor mission end to end, including research, reasoning, coding, browser inspection, correction, checkpoint, resume, and verification, with durable evidence in canonical Brain.

concrete_real_mission.title: Build and validate the Project Brain Capability Reality Auditor
concrete_real_mission.consequence: This tool becomes the fail-closed guard against false capability promotion and directly protects the capability-realization mission.
task: Read the live canonical pointer, mandatory laws, Astra target capability map, correction artifacts, and worker identities.
Use current official OpenAI Astra documentation only as an external target reference, never as a grading shortcut.
Implement a runnable auditor inside the Brain repository that checks canonical state for contradictions and invalid promotion patterns.

At minimum detect: internal-suite-to-external-parity inflation; component-evidence composition into one worker; P_real mismatch with worker identities; stale or contradictory mission/frontier state; forbidden Val Town/Sprites routes; missing capability-realization mission lock; benchmark/predicate proxy-goal substitution.
Create deterministic regression fixtures for the known 2026-09-22 failures and make the auditor fail closed on them.
Generate both a machine-readable JSON report and a human-readable HTML report from the live canonical state.
Run the auditor and its tests on the live repository.
Open the HTML report in a browser/computer environment and visually inspect it for correctness and usability.
If the auditor discovers a real live inconsistency, repair only the evidence-supported metadata defect, rerun the audit, and preserve before/after evidence.
Persist a durable checkpoint to canonical Brain after analysis and before implementation.
Resume the same worker identity from that checkpoint after a session/context boundary without repeating completed analysis.
Finish with tests green, live audit clean or explicitly blocked by a real unresolved issue, and durable evidence committed.
